ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The cross-section of a certain flood control embankment is the trapezoid ABCD as shown in the figure, with the dam height $AH=3$ meters and the slope of the water-facing side AB being $i=1\colon3$. What is the length of the slope AB in meters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the slope of embankment AB has a slope $i=1\colon 3$,\\
$AH=3$ meters,\\
$\therefore BH=9$ meters.\\
By the Pythagorean theorem, it follows that $AB=\sqrt{BH^{2}+AH^{2}}=3\sqrt{10}$ meters.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $AB=\boxed{3\sqrt{10}}$ meters.
